content.name: Katharina Brandt
content.title: Head of Accounting
content.summary: Certified accountant (Geprüfte Bilanzbuchhalterin IHK) with 15 years in manufacturing, logistics and fintech. Leads a team of seven responsible for HGB and IFRS reporting for a payments group with €180 million in revenue, and brought the annual financial statements forward by six weeks.

experience.title: Head of Accounting
bullets: Lead a seven-person accounting team covering general ledger, payables, intercompany and fixed assets for four legal entities.
Prepare HGB single-entity accounts and the IFRS group reporting package, finishing the annual statements six weeks earlier than in 2020.
Introduced automated bank-statement matching in SAP S/4HANA, raising the auto-clearing rate from 55% to 91%.
Act as main contact for the auditors and the tax adviser during annual audits and the 2023 tax field audit (Betriebsprüfung).

experience.title: Senior Accountant
bullets: Owned the monthly close and the HGB-to-IFRS reconciliation for a logistics group with 2,400 employees.
Restructured the intercompany clearing process across nine subsidiaries, cutting open intercompany differences from €1.2 million to under €50,000.
Prepared VAT pre-returns (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen) and the annual VAT return for German and Austrian entities.
Trained two junior accountants and an apprentice (Auszubildende) in DATEV and SAP FI.

experience.title: Accountant
bullets: Kept the general ledger and accounts payable for a plastics manufacturer with €65 million turnover.
Prepared fixed asset postings and depreciation for two production sites.
Supported the year-end inventory count and the valuation of 6,000 stock items.
